ProblemSection.title: You hired solutions. You're managing conflicts.
ProblemSection.description: The people who understand the subject sit on the other side of the table. The developer pushes change orders, the systems don't talk to each other and, in the field, the electrical design doesn't match the automation. Each supplier answers for its own part. Nobody answers for the whole.

ScenarioComparison.without_point_1: Three contracts, three versions of the truth. You become the integrator without being hired for it.
ScenarioComparison.without_point_2: Every delay becomes a change order. Without technical grounding, you can't tell what's fair.
ScenarioComparison.without_point_3: The result: wasted cash and loss of control over your own investment.
ScenarioComparison.with_title: One technical lead. On your side.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_1: We take over technical governance end to end. You decide on deadline, cost and priority.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_2: We hold suppliers to deadline, quality and scope until final acceptance.
ScenarioComparison.with_point_3: We eliminate financial, tax and operational risks before they become costs.
ScenarioComparison.without_svg_label: Without Boomerang: you are tied to three suppliers, and the problem gets pushed from one to the other.
ScenarioComparison.with_svg_label: With Boomerang: you talk to a single lead, who coordinates and holds the three suppliers accountable and hands back an accepted delivery.
ScenarioComparison.suppliers_caption: held to deadline, quality and scope

FrontsSection.title: From the code to the electrical panel.
FrontsSection.description: Three fronts, one single accountability. From code audits to infrastructure compatibility.

digital.title: Digital projects
digital.body: Governance of architecture, code quality and development pipelines. We make sure the software house delivers the right product, not the one that's easiest to bill.

cyber_physical.title: Cyber-physical projects
cyber_physical.body: Convergence between active infrastructure and the digital layer, such as IoT and automation. This is where the electrical and automation designs need to match, and they almost never do on their own.
cyber_physical.item_2: Interface engineering between systems and machines

compliance.title: Protection and compliance
compliance.body: Auditing of technical contracts and oversight of subcontractors, so your company doesn't inherit joint or secondary liability risks.
compliance.item_3: Reduction of tax and labor risks

MomentsSection.title: What stage is your project at?
MomentsSection.description: Our work doesn't depend on your industry. It depends on the risk. Pick the situation closest to yours.

MomentPicker.cta: I want to talk about this

stalled.situation: The project stalled and the deadline blew up
stalled.headline: We assign responsibilities and stop the losses.
stalled.body: We step in with a rapid technical intervention: we audit what was delivered, what was billed and what's missing. You walk away with a map of the problem and of who answers for it.
stalled.service: Technical Health Check, in 3 to 5 days

expansion.situation: I'm going to expand, automate or replace the ERP
expansion.headline: We define the technical requirements before you sign.
expansion.body: A new plant, automation or a core ERP replacement. We structure what needs to be delivered and how it will be accepted, before suppliers are hired.

integration.situation: The equipment arrived and the infrastructure can't support it
integration.headline: We get the machine, the system and the installation talking.
integration.body: The machinery or the system arrived, but the infrastructure can't keep up. We solve the interface engineering and run field commissioning.
integration.service: Full Governance or Advisory per phase

ServicesSection.title: Start with the diagnosis. Stay for the results.
ServicesSection.description: Three ways to work together, from a one-off check to full governance. With the last one, we earn more when you save.

health_check.title: Technical Health Check
health_check.description: A 3 to 5 day diagnosis to review proposals before signing or audit delayed projects. It reveals the hidden financial risks.

advisory.title: Advisory and Audit
advisory.description: Technical validation at the milestones that decide the project: RFP, supplier sourcing and commissioning.

governance.title: Full Governance
governance.description: We take over the technical management of the project from kickoff to acceptance, with fees tied to your results.
governance.billing_note: tied to deadline, budget and avoided change orders
